verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a versioned REST API (QuickBooks Online V3 REST API) with SDKs and OAuth support, but there is no documentation of a deprecation policy, version sunset timeline, or migration guidance; probes for OpenAPI/llms.txt specs return 404s, suggesting weak machine-readable API documentation. Missing for 10: documented deprecation/versioning policy, changelog or sunset schedule, machine-readable API spec.
